observed: With a non-empty draft, Escape closes the slash popup but keeps the text. Every later Escape is dead. Only Ctrl+U clears the line. A follow-up /help then sends /mod/help to the model as a prompt.
expected: Escape with a draft clears it (or backs out one level and says so). The clearing key is shown in the hints.
note: deliberate per README ('Esc unpins scroll then aborts')

observed: Popup is about 58 columns wide on a 120-column terminal and truncates its description with an ellipsis: 'permission mode (ask|accept_edits|allow|re...'
expected: Popup width follows the available width up to the longest description, or wraps.

observed: Hints use inconsistent separators (runs of spaces, no glyph). '/ commands' appears twice at idle (placeholder and border). At 80x24 only two hints survive. (An earlier version of this row claimed the hints were bold. They are not: checked in the harness frame and in the real binary's escape output.)
expected: One separator convention, hint priority that keeps the most useful ones at narrow widths, and no duplicate.
note: bold claim withdrawn after checking the escapes

observed: A badge reads '⊘1' from the first frame with no legend anywhere on screen.
expected: The badge names what it counts, or its hover/legend is reachable.

observed: When the model returns no reasoning, every step prints '✻ Thinking' plus 'No reasoning available.' Four of these fill the whole first screen of a real session.
expected: Nothing is printed for empty reasoning unless the user asked to see thinking.

observed: A raw model control token leaks into the transcript: 'No reasoning available.<|start|>'.
expected: Control tokens are stripped at the wire, as data in the dialect catalog.

observed: Card text is cut near column 62 with a fold chevron while the card's right rail sits at column 118. The right half of every card is empty.
expected: Card text uses the transcript width; the fold appears only when the content exceeds it.

observed: An empty list opens a 78-column box with two blank rows for one line of text.
expected: An empty state hugs its message.

expected: An unknown /word is refused with 'unknown command' and the nearest match, and the strip labels match commands.

observed: Every slash command leaves a full prompt band in the transcript (amber rail, own row, spacing), so opening five panels adds ten rows of chrome.
expected: Commands echo as one dim line, or not at all for panels that open immediately.

observed: Hint rows advertise keys the content cannot use: pgup/pgdn and home/end on one-line panels (debug, doctor, hooks), choose and open on empty lists (spills, tasks).
expected: Hints appear only when they apply.

expected: Truncate with an ellipsis, or let the row wrap, or widen the panel.

observed: Twelve of sixteen rows carry a red cross for an unset key. The panel reads as an error state.
expected: Not configured is dim, not red. Red is for failures.

observed: Raw Markdown markers are printed: '#' and '###' on headings, backticks around code.
expected: Rendered as the transcript renders Markdown.

observed: Rows show developer ids: 'read (tool:read)', 'config + .ka/hooks (hooks)', 'pathfinder (tool:pathfinder)'.
expected: A row shows its name and, at most, the config key that rules it.
